title: Providers & Models
description: Connect API providers and manage models available locally or through provider endpoints.
desktopAgentsDescription: Use supported AI agents already installed and signed in on this computer. Enabled agents run with their available tools, MCP servers, and skills without per-action confirmation.
agentAcpDescription: Knovum starts each Agent through ACP and uses the capabilities declared by that Agent for text, images, audio, and attached resources.
agentMcpDescription: The current Space is connected automatically through a private MCP session with search, provenance, history, relations, and atomic knowledge changes.
agentArtifactsDescription: Agents can create documents, images, audio, video, and other files with their own tools and Skills. Knovum imports only the results you select.
agentDetectionBoundary: Detection confirms command entries, not sign-in or ACP connectivity.

nativeCli.title: Native ACP
nativeCli.requirements: Install an official CLI with ACP support and add its command directory to PATH.

nodeAdapter.title: ACP adapter
nodeAdapter.requirements: Requires the official CLI and Node.js (npx). First use may download the ACP adapter.

standaloneServer.title: Standalone ACP server
standaloneServer.requirements: Download the official ACP archive, keep its companion files, and add the server directory to PATH.

agentDocumentationOpenFailed: Could not open the Agent's official link
desktopAgentNotReady: This Agent has not completed ACP initialization.
desktopAgentInstallHint: Install and sign in through the agent’s official application, then check again.
connectionsDescription: Configure API providers and the models available through each connection.
imageLayersDescription: Use fal's Qwen Image Layered model to separate images into independent RGBA layers. The credential stays in the local credential database.
falApiKeyDescription: Used only for image layer splitting. It stays in the local credential database and is read by the Rust execution layer.
addConnectionDescription: Enter the provider endpoint and at least one model. You can add the API key after the provider is created.
deleteConnectionConfirm: Delete {name}? Its credentials will also be removed.
noConnectionsDescription: Add a provider to use cloud or self-hosted models for writing, knowledge work, translation, and media generation.
addModelDescription: Use the exact model identifier expected by this provider, then select the tasks it supports.
defaultRoutesDescription: Choose a model or desktop Agent for each purpose. Neither execution channel is preferred automatically.
executionRoutingDescription: Set the execution target for each task. Model APIs and compatible desktop Agents are equal choices controlled by you.
executionTargetAgentReady: Desktop Agent · ACP verified · uses its current tools, MCP servers, and Skills
executionTargetAgentWorkflow: Desktop Agent · output depends on its current tools and Skills
routingUnavailableDescription: Add a model provider or enable a detected desktop Agent before choosing execution defaults.
knowledgeRouteDescription: Answers, summaries, and reasoning grounded in space content.
visualUnderstandingRouteDescription: Analyze images and video frames for search and knowledge retrieval.
imageGenerationRouteDescription: Create images from instructions and space context.
videoGenerationRouteDescription: Create videos from instructions and source material.
